statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); output_style=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.output_style.name'); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); git_info=" (${branch})"; else git_info=""; fi; printf "\033[36m%s\033[0m%s \033[35m%s\033[0m \033[33m[%s]\033[0m" "$dir_name" "$git_info" "$model" "$output_style"
